Using Tennisimo

Tennisimo analyses tennis videos you record or upload and gives you measurements and coaching tips. By creating an account you agree to these terms and to the Privacy Policy.

You keep ownership of the videos you upload. You give us permission to store and process them only to provide the service to you. Only upload videos you have the right to use, and do not film people who have not agreed to it.

Measurements and coaching

Scores, speeds and line calls are estimates from phone video and can be wrong. Coaching tips are general guidance, not professional or medical advice. Warm up, play within your limits and stop if something hurts.
